description:
👍Excellent shock-proof function: The body is equipped with high-strength shock-absorbing springs, which have strong shock-absorbing ability and make no noise when driving.

🔋 Long battery life: The rechargeable 36V sealed lithium battery system provides you with long-distance battery life of up to 40-60KM in all scenarios. It only takes 4-5 hours to fully charge. Equipped with 48V charger, greatly shortening charging time . Top speed can reach 22MPH.

🚴UNIQUE 3-SPEED MODE: The electric motocross bike features 3-speed modes - low, medium and high. You can choose to use any speed to give you the best riding experience.
Adopt disc brake system: better braking performance‌, longer service life‌, lower maintenance cost, better heat dissipation performance

🚲 DURABLE AND STRONG: Designed specifically for kids ages 5-13, the electric motorcycle features true dirt bike geometry for a reliable off-road riding experience.

👍 Efficient support team: If you still need help, you can contact us. We will be online for you 24 hours a day.

🚴Tips：When riding, please wear a helmet and take protective measures. Parents are asked to accompany children as much as possible when riding.
